acceptance_criteria: Auto-compact health exposes a typed current episode separately from lifetime totals, with an explicit state, scope, generation, start time, last transition, and recovery evidence.
Per-scope cleanup, session replacement, and shutdown close or reset current episode state without erasing cumulative diagnostic totals.
Runtime health derives degradation only from a current unresolved auto-compact episode and cannot infer current risk from a positive lifetime counter.
The external health checker consumes the typed episode contract rather than treating every positive auto-compact integer as a generic at-risk marker.
A healthy response with only historical auto-compact totals remains healthy after the current episode has recovered.
An active rapid-rearm or ineffective-compaction episode produces a warning with bounded reason-bearing evidence and clears only after a verified recovery transition.
Counter and episode semantics are documented consistently for runtime, deployment checks, operators, and alert consumers.
Focused tests prove warning onset, historical-total non-warning, cleanup, shutdown, scope isolation, restart generation, stale episode rejection, and verified recovery.
blast_radius: Agent auto-compaction health, external health-probe severity, BOT ERRORS and watchdog interpretation, operator alerts, cleanup and shutdown semantics, and documentation of runtime health counters.
evidence_summary: Three live identity reads spanning 23 seconds pinned open issue #2541 to node I_kwDOR1Sep88AAAABKQsXuA, its current title, P1, SSOT, alerts, audit, bug, and reliability labels, update time, URL, and exact 9,898-byte body hash while the SSH remote main remained 9a1bd7b3d3c529b276c1ad764d2c312d7f3abfc3. Exact-main source inspection confirms AutoCompactController increments three cumulative counters and explicitly leaves cumulative health counters intact during shutdown; cleanup removes scoped scheduling state without resetting those totals. Runtime health reports the counters but does not use them in its own status predicate. The external health checker iterates those integers with other runtime counters and adds runtime_agent_at_risk whenever any is positive. A direct exact-main falsifier supplied a top-level healthy response with no active sessions and positive historical auto-compact totals: both the original sample and a later idle sample returned WARN 200 with runtime_agent_at_risk. Exact-main controls passed 219 tests across the controller, runtime-adjacent health, durability, approvals, poll persistence, and external health-check suites. Merged PRs #717 and #1007 are partial historical implementations. A fresh complete open-PR changed-file scan found 21 touched-path collisions plus one acceptance-criteria coordination overlap and no implementation owner; exact-term issue and pull-request searches found no additional owner.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if cleanup or shutdown cleared a typed current auto-compact episode, runtime and external health distinguished that current state from lifetime totals, or a healthy later-idle payload containing only historical totals remained non-warning. Exact source inspection and the direct two-sample health probe disproved those conditions. The 219 passing issue-relevant and control tests establish current behavior, not the missing episode contract. This audit did not observe a production warning, measure alert frequency, or choose episode aging thresholds, so operational incidence and alert calibration remain implementation-time measurement obligations.
impact: One historical ineffective compaction or rapid rearm can make the external health view warn indefinitely even after the session and scoped state are gone. Operators cannot distinguish an active compaction risk from harmless lifetime history, creating sticky false warnings and weakening trust in real alerts.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2541 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and every decisive path byte; reject integration on revision drift until the evidence is rerun.
Re-scan every open pull request and merged PRs #717 and #1007 before dispatch; preserve a single owner and coordinate #2451 taxonomy semantics without treating it as the episode owner.
Specify the typed current-episode and lifetime-total schema, scope and generation identity, transition timestamps, and recovery predicate before changing alert severity.
Prove cleanup, session replacement, scope rekey, and shutdown close current state while retaining cumulative totals for diagnostics.
Update runtime and external consumers atomically or provide a versioned compatibility path that cannot interpret historical totals as current risk.
Add RED and GREEN tests for active ineffective compaction, later idle health, per-scope cleanup, shutdown, rekey, concurrent scopes, restart generation, stale payloads, and verified recovery.
Repeat the healthy-body direct falsifier and require the original active episode to warn while the later recovered sample remains healthy.
Run all three decisive suites plus broader health and deployment checks against committed implementation bytes.

suggested_remediation: Model auto-compaction as a typed per-scope current episode with generation and transition evidence, separate from lifetime totals. Close current state during cleanup, replacement, and shutdown while retaining cumulative diagnostics. Make runtime and external health consume the same current-episode contract, warn only for an unresolved episode, and require a verified recovery transition before clearing it. Version or coordinate the producer and consumer change so historical totals can never be reinterpreted as current risk.
